description: Create a new text note in Speak AI for analysis. The content will be analyzed for insights, topics, and sentiment. Uses one text note from the plan allowance, and once the allowance is used up charges credits, the account balance, or the card on file; the request is refused only when none of these can cover it. Sends the text.created and text.analyzed events to the workspace's webhooks and Slack channels if any are configured.

callbackUrl.description: URL that replaces the workspace webhook's destination for this note's webhook events. It takes effect only when the workspace already has an active webhook for the event; on its own it does not create a webhook or send anything.

fields.description: Custom field values to attach to the text note

id.description: Field `id` from list_fields or create_field (12 characters), never the database `_id`

folderId.description: ID of the folder to place the note in

tags.description: Comma-separated tags or array of tag strings

name: create_text_note

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Create Text Note
